description: Four envelope generators with built-in VCAs, sharing one trigger and one gate, each multiplying its own input by a linear ADSR envelope.

params.text: Sets the attack time of that envelope, 1ms to 10 seconds.
Sets the decay time of that envelope, 1ms to 10 seconds.
Sets the level that envelope holds at while sustaining, 0 to 100% of its peak.
Sets the release time of that envelope, 1ms to 10 seconds.
Sets the overall level of that envelope, 0 to 100%, which scales what its VCA passes.

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2.5V starts the attack phase of all four envelopes, whatever the gate is doing.
A gate rising above 2.5V starts all four envelopes; while it stays high they hold at their sustain level, and the release phase starts when it falls.
The signal multiplied by that envelope and sent to the matching output; the expected range is -5V to +5V. Patch a steady 10V here to take the bare envelope from the output.
Adds to the attack time set for that envelope; +10V raises it by the full range of the knob and -10V lowers it by the same.
Adds to the decay time set for that envelope; +10V raises it by the full range of the knob and -10V lowers it by the same.
Adds to the sustain level set for that envelope; +10V raises it by the full range of the knob and -10V lowers it by the same.
Adds to the release time set for that envelope; +10V raises it by the full range of the knob and -10V lowers it by the same.
Adds to the overall level set for that envelope; +10V raises it by the full range of the knob and -10V lowers it by the same.

outputs.text: Carries the signal from that operator's input multiplied by its envelope.

notes: nothing comes out until a rising edge arrives at the shared TRIG or GATE input, and a signal is patched into that operator's own input.
with only a trigger patched, the envelope uses its attack and release phases alone; with a steady high gate and full sustain it stays open, which turns the module into four VCAs.
menu: Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.

inputs.0:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the GATE jack.
inputs.1: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
